killedBy: createStatsStore: the CAMPAIGN RUN scope startRun zeroes the run tally and ONLY the run tally
why: The opposite error, and the more destructive one: pressing New Game erases the player's whole history. Plausible precisely because the two scopes now sit next to each other in this file and `resetStats` legitimately clears both -- copying its body into `startRun` is a one-paste mistake. The `ONLY the run tally` half of the test is what stands between that and a shipped data-loss bug.
